In-force facility ban across all government buildings with criminal trespass, ID-fraud treatment, adult care barriers; one arrest shows enforcement; parent federal regime compounds. High risk.
Bathroom-bounty law lets any private person sue for shared facility use, with criminal/civil penalties; license invalidation; Do Not Travel. Worst documented universal exposure.

Courts repeatedly enjoin anti-trans laws; facility ban restrained, care ban struck down; but hostile 2026 sex-definition law enacted and religious-freedom law remain. Parent federal exposure caps safety.

Most Protective tier: shield law, GI anti-discrimination, hate-crime coverage, X markers, custody-by-identity policy. State layer strongly offsets parent federal hostility, but federal passport/entry/facility rules cap score.
